artworks.title: Design for a City Gate in Trier
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and watercolor over traces of graphite on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural designs showcasing archways and elevations. On the left side, there is an ornate archway with classical detailing including columns, a triangular pediment, and a central cartouche, topped with a decorative sculpture suggesting maritime themes. On the right, there is a cross-sectional view of a simplified arch structure highlighted in pink tones, illustrating a cut-through side view of the arch. Both designs are annotated with measurements and notes, likely for construction or architectural planning. The drawing emphasizes symmetry and ornamental design in an architectural context.

artworks.title: River Landscape with a Waterfall (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and red wash, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a turbulent stream with rushing water flowing towards the viewer. The scene is surrounded by tall rocks and dense foliage that obscure the horizon. Trees with branches extending over the water and leaves scattered across the top of the image. The brushstrokes are rapid and expressive, giving a loose, sketch-like quality to the scene. The color palette is earthy with muted greens and browns contrasting with the whites and grays of the water.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of red and black chalk, squared for transfer with black chalk, on cream laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall: 41.5 x 19.7 cm (16 5/16 x 7 3/4 in.), arched top
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical or religious scene. The drawing shows several figures in different positions and actions. The composition is divided into two main sections with figures in the upper levels and lower levels. The upper section appears to depict a group of figures witnessing or participating in an event. The lower section shows figures in dynamic poses with swords or engaged in struggle. The scene is detailed with a brownish wash for tonal contrast.

artworks.title: The Flaying of Marsyas
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white on greenish laid paper (originally blue)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene under a tree with figures in various poses. One figure is tied to the tree while another interacts with them, with other figures in the background. The drawing features light and shading to create depth and realism, showcasing dynamic action and emotion.

artworks.title: Faun Reclining
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on light brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a man from the hips upward. The man is in a dynamic position, with one arm raised above his head and the other bent at elbow level with the fingers pointing downward. His head is turned slightly to his left as he looks over his shoulder. His facial features include a furrowed brow, a prominent nose, and a slightly open mouth revealing teeth, with a full beard and mustache. The man's hair is short and somewhat curly, adorned with a wreath of leaves and grapes. He is unclothed, showcasing a muscular torso with well-defined anatomical details. The background of the image is plain and unembellished.

artworks.title: Plague Victims Pleading for Help from Christ, the Virgin, and Saint Roch
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white gouache, with a small patched pasted over the head of the Virgin and then redrawn
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a scene. The upper portion features three figures on clouds, with the central figure holding objects, giving an impression of power. The surrounding figures seem to be in a posture of reverence. In the lower section, multiple figures are shown in various states of movement, with architectural elements in the background. The use of light and shadow, alongside intricate detailing, adds depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Saint Roch Interceding on Behalf of Plague Victims
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white gouache on paper washed brown
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a gathering under a figure in the clouds. The central figure is ascending on a cloud with attendants. Below, a crowd of individuals is gathered, looking upwards. The scene includes architectural elements and has a dramatic contrast of white highlights on brownish paper. The figures are detailed with shadows and lines in flowing robes, typical of the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Studies of Glass Jars and Figures (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on light tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various studies and sketches on a single sheet of paper. The page is filled with a collection of small sketches, depicting a variety of subjects including humans, animals, and objects. The figures include a muscular torso in the foreground, alongside several sketched busts with expressive faces. To the right, there are two small round vases with shaded detail. Also present are sketches of a horse's head and dynamic, swift strokes suggesting movement, such as a galloping horse and rider at the bottom of the page and playful cherubic figures. The use of brown ink wash over pencil outlines gives the drawing a warm tonal quality. The composition suggests it may be a preliminary or practice sheet used by the artist to explore different shapes and forms, with some sketches appearing more detailed and finished than others.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.medium: red chalk on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays swirling and curved lines creating an abstract composition. In the center, there is a figure wrapped in flowing fabric or flames, with a gesture suggesting movement. The lines can evoke a windswept cloak or chaotic fire around the figure, giving a sense of motion and energy. The figures are sketch-like, appearing like ghostly images floating among swirling clouds or smoke.

artworks.title: Two Nude Children Lifting a Cudgel
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white chalk on paper washed ochre, partially squared for transfer in red chalk
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of two young children in dynamic poses. At the top of the sketch is a child sitting with one knee bent, facing the right. They are using one arm to carry a large log or beam on their shoulder. They have short, curly hair and are nude. Below them is a sketch of another child who is also kneeling, their body facing us and their head turned to the right. They are leaning forward with their arms extended to the left, using both hands to pull a long pole. This child has short, straight hair, and they appear to have cloth wrapped around their waist. There are other partial sketches on the page, including part of an arm surrounded by cloth in the bottom right corner and a hand holding a curved object near the upper right corner. The background is a sepia-toned paper with faint grid lines, and the sketches are done in pale red.

artworks.title: Head of a Man Looking Up
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over charcoal, heightened with white chalk on ochre prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and part of the shoulders. The face is turned upwards in a slightly diagonal and upward-right angle, with expressive lines defining features such as brows and a nose. The person's hair is depicted as wavy and voluminous, flowing outward. Minimal lines suggest clothing over the shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects held. The background features a plain, textured surface with crosshatching and sweeping lines for depth.

artworks.title: The Banquet of Acheloüs
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown and blue-gray washes, heightened with white gouache on laid paper washed light brown
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered around a lavish table within a rocky grotto. The scene depicts an elaborate setting with numerous figures seated and interacting at a grand table adorned with various vessels and platters. The background is composed of rock formations. The figures are engaged in animated discussion or activity, enhancing the liveliness of the composition. The setting in natural rock and the presence of abundant food and drink evoke a sense of abundance and communal gathering.

artworks.title: Christ before Herod
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray-brown wash, heightened with white gouache, on brown prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of a historical scene with figures in classical attire. The image shows a gathering of figures, with one seated on a throne elevated on a platform, flanked by others who seem to be guards wielding spears. The seated figure is under a canopy, and is engaging with standing figures who appear to be in discussion or negotiation, with some in supplication or distress. The setting is a grand architectural space, with columns and arches in the background. The artwork uses a monochromatic palette of brown and beige tones, giving it a sculptural and historic feel.

artworks.title: The Ruins of an Ancient Amphitheater
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk  on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an ancient stone structure from a slightly elevated angle, showcasing arches and intricate masonry details up close. The composition lacks a horizon and emphasizes the architecture and its immediate surroundings. The structure extends upward beyond the frame. The artist uses a loose and expressive technique, with sketchy ink lines and light gray and brown washes for shadow and depth. The muted color palette includes shades of gray, brown, and cream, giving the artwork a monochromatic and classical look. The brushwork highlights the stone's texture and the play of light, conveying the structure's aged appearance.

artworks.title: The Supper at Emmaus
artworks.medium: black chalk with pen and brown ink and brown wash with touches of red chalk, heightened with white gouache on laid paper washed tan, with some outlines incised for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two men seated at a table, with their upper bodies visible. The man on the left is leaning back with his hands raised, while the man on the right faces him with his hands gesturing upward. Both men have beards and are dressed in draped clothing. The table is covered with a cloth, and there are objects on it. The background includes an ornate architectural setting with columns and adornments.

artworks.title: Alexander the Great before the Corpse of Darius
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk, brown and gray and red wash, strengthened with pen and black ink and tip of the brush with black wash, heighteend with white gouache (laid on eighteeneth century paper)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of soldiers gathered around a fallen warrior. The scene is set in a wooded area with large trees and tents in the background. The central fallen warrior is adorned with armor and a helmet, lying on the ground, clutching a shield. Surrounding him, several other warriors, also clad in detailed armor, appear to be attending to or mourning him. The figures are detailed, showcasing intricate armor and helmets with plumes. Horses are present, one being ridden by a soldier in the foreground. In the background, trees are depicted with a delicate texture, and the sky has soft clouds. The composition conveys a sense of camaraderie and the gravity of the situation.

artworks.title: Head of a Boy (Gennaro Falcone?)
artworks.medium: red chalk on oatmeal paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of the head and neck of a young person. The person is looking downward, with their eyes closed and lips slightly curved. They have short, wavy hair falling gently around their head. The drawing is done in red chalk on textured beige paper, emphasizing delicate lines and shading. There are no clothing details, with a minimal background. In the lower left corner, there is a signature, and a small stamp is in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Male Nude Reclining on a Bed
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper washed ocher
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining on a soft surface with pillows. The individual is relaxed, with one arm by their side and one leg bent inward. They have wavy medium-length hair, a serene expression, closed eyes, and slightly parted lips. The person is unclothed and not wearing any jewelry or accessories. The background is a simple textured surface.

artworks.title: A Seated Male Nude
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person seated with their legs crossed, leaning slightly to the right. One arm is resting on their knee while the other hangs to the side. The person's facial features are undefined, and their hair is drawn with flowing lines. They are depicted as nude, sitting on a surface resembling cloth. The background is a plain blue-gray color.

artworks.title: Male Nude Leaning on His Elbow (verso)
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure from the knees up, reclining with one arm resting on a surface and the other across his abdomen. His facial features are depicted with simple lines, his hair is short and tousled. He is nude, sketched in a classical style with red chalk, highlighting his muscular build and anatomy. The background is a plain muted blue-gray color, emphasizing the figure in the foreground. No jewelry or objects are shown in the sketch.

artworks.title: The Four Elements
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of four individuals. The first seated person, to the left, is a muscular figure with short hair, using dividers against a surface near a large wheel. Next to them is a woman seated on a surface, wearing a draped garment and a headband, with long hair cascading down her back. The third individual, seated at the center, has a long beard and is dressed in long robes, resting their head thoughtfully on one hand. The standing figure on the right has short, flowing hair and is draped in loose fabric, holding a horn with both hands as if playing it. The background is minimal.

artworks.title: The Coronation of the Virgin
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and some gray ink with brown wash over charcoal on brown prepared oatmeal paper, heightened with white
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene. The image shows several figures surrounded by clouds and light, with a larger figure in the center being crowned by two others. The figures have different postures, some standing, others sitting or reclining among swirling clouds. The composition creates a dynamic and harmonious arrangement, with movement directed towards the central figures. The style of the drawing features intricate lines, detailed shading, and themes of divinity and ethereality commonly seen in religious artwork.

artworks.title: A Wine Decanter with Lions and Putti
artworks.artist: Master of the Medici Banquet Decanters
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with blue wash over graphite on light beige laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a tree with crest-like elements. The drawing features a tree with a shield-like structure at its center, adorned with circular forms and a crown. Two humanoid figures with animalistic features are integrated into the branches. The line work is detailed, with hatching and shading for texture and depth.

artworks.title: A Wine Decanter with Two Fighting Sea Horses
artworks.artist: Master of the Medici Banquet Decanters
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with blue wash over graphite on light beige laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Vincent and Linda Buonanno
artworks.description: The image shows swirling, curling lines forming an intricate and abstract arrangement resembling a hybrid creature. Two horse-like heads are at the top, merging and intertwining with flowing manes. Below, the lines transition into snake-like curves, extending downward and morphing into a fish-like tail with fins flaring out. The composition blends elements of different animals in an imaginative way.
